title: Hannah McRoberts flying saucer photo

plain: On October 8, 1981, a woman named Hannah McRoberts was out driving with her husband on Vancouver Island, Canada, and stopped near a well-known mountain, and that stop is where her photo of a flying saucer comes from. The researcher Clas Svahn tells it, passing on what McRoberts herself described and pointing to a collection he calls the Files of the Unexplained. He tells it because the photo would be a picture of a real saucer if it shows what it seems to.
